features.name: IS_NULL() and IS_NOT_NULL(): test whether a field is blank
features.description: Two new comparison functions in the formula builder. `IS_NULL({field})` is true when the; field is blank; `IS_NOT_NULL({field})` is its exact opposite. Both work in a formula field, in a; condition, and inside a `.where()` filter on a record aggregate.
features.impact: There was no way to ask "is this field empty?". COALESCE was being used for it and gets it; wrong: COALESCE only falls through `null`/`undefined`/`NaN`, so it RETURNS an empty string rather; than falling through to the fallback — `COALESCE({a}, "x")` is `""` when `{a}` is a cleared text; box. `IF(IS_NULL({a}), "x", {a})` is the correct form.

features.name: Seed the new `popover` component (properties section + palette)
features.description: Added the `popover` component to the seeders so it appears in the builder palette; (Layout group) and its Properties panel renders the **"Popover Properties"** section.; `seedComponentProperties.js`: new entry `fieldType: 'popover'` with; `propertyGroups.basic: [{ sectionName: 'Popover Properties', fields: [] }]`. The frontend; `PopoverProperties` panel reads `componentData` directly and writes every setting under; `basic.popover*`, so `fields:[]` is intentional (same as `modal` / `payment-mode`).; `seedComponentListHardcoded.js`: added `{ type: 'popover', label: 'Popover', icon:; 'MessageSquare', isAtomicComponent: false }` to the Layout Components group, after `modal`.
features.impact: A popover is a trigger (icon, text or both) that opens a panel on the top, bottom, left; or right of it; the panel holds any dropped components. The palette and the properties sections; are DB-seeded, so a new component type needs both entries to show up.

features.name: Every release-note template resolves completely (presets + custom)
features.description: New `releaseTemplateFields.service.js`. Generate/Preview/Download load the selected template, and every; `{{token}}` resolves:; (a) document tokens;; (b) fact tokens derived from data: product_name, environment, build_number, previous_version,; release_owner/prepared_by/owner (plain workspace username; encrypted values are decrypted, never printed),; modules_affected, release_month, release_datetime, hotfix_title/version, change_counts, changelog_entries,; new_features_table, enhancements_table, bug_fixes_table, known_issues_table;; (c) any other token (preset fields such as deployment_steps/root_cause, or custom variables) is sent to the; AI by name as `templateFields`, falling back to "Not specified in the release information." The AI is told; never to invent IDs, numbers, dates, names or statuses.; Business Notes become structured `document.notes` (Highlights, Coming Soon, Important Notes, Migration Steps,; Known Issues with Description/Impact/Status, Limitations, Support). They are only expanded from what the author; wrote: an empty note stays empty, and the AI can no longer fill it from scratch.; `{{release_document}}` now includes those note sections, and the summary table has Category / Module / Item /; Status, including known issues, coming-soon and migration rows. Empty change sections read; "No bug fixes were documented for this release."; `draftRelease()` is the single drafting pipeline for Generate/Preview and generate-pdf-with-ai.; `normalizeFlowPositioning` unwraps lists whose items only hold block content, so a token placed as a bullet; (including in already-saved templates) doesn't render as one indented bullet.

features.name: IS_NULL() and IS_NOT_NULL() in the formula builder
features.description: The formula builder's Comparison group has two new entries, `IS_NULL()` and; `IS_NOT_NULL()`. `IS_NULL({field})` is true when the field is blank — empty, spaces only, or never; filled in. A `0` or an unticked checkbox is a value, not a blank. Autocomplete and the help panel; carry both, including the note that COALESCE differs.
features.impact: There was no way to ask "is this field empty?" in a formula. COALESCE was being used for; it and returns an empty string instead of falling through, so `COALESCE({a}, "x")` is `""` for a; cleared text box. `IF(IS_NULL({a}), "x", {a})` is the correct form, and the help text says so.

features.name: AI-failure banner; "Detailed Release Document" preset
features.description: PreviewTab shows an amber banner with the reason and a Retry button when the release's; AI integration was requested but failed (`aiStatus`). New Template Library preset; "Detailed Release Document" (category "Detailed Document"): header (version, title, date, type),; Key Highlights, `{{release_document}}` (numbered overview → module sections → summary table →; overall benefits → conclusion), then Additional Notes from Business Notes. Change-type presets; such as "Complete Release Outline" still group by New Features/Enhancements/…; the module-grouped; numbered layout needs `{{release_document}}`.

features.name: All 14 Template Library presets generate from real data
features.description: Presets no longer contain hardcoded sample content:; Feature-Based uses `{{module_sections}}`.; Change-Type uses new_features/improvements/bug_fixes/known_issues/breaking_changes.; Customer's placeholder bullets are replaced with real sections.; Version-/Date-Based use `{{change_counts}}` + `{{changelog_entries}}`.; Changelog uses `{{changelog_entries}}`.; Sprint uses list sections instead of `_1/_2/_3` fields.; Build's single-row tables are replaced with real `*_table` tokens.; Detailed Release Document is now header + `{{release_document}}`, which contains all notes.; `section()` renders a single-token section as a block (not a `<li>`).; PreviewTab:; unwraps block-only lists (mirrors the backend);; appends uncovered notes as rich HTML and skips them when the template uses `{{release_document}}`;; re-renders after a template switch so the new template's fields are drafted.; The editor's ReleaseNote variable list includes the new fact and table tokens.

features.name: Show/hide each part of the bar above the records list, from Transaction Settings
features.description: Transaction Settings has a new **Header & Toolbar** card (after Column Search). It lists; every part of the bar above a feature's records list, in screen order, each with a checkbox:; **Header:** Title · Published badge · Record count ("Showing 16 of 16 records").; **Toolbar:** Sort by · Sort direction (↑↓) · View buttons, with one row per view and an; *Opens in** picker (the default view) · Search box · Filters · Create.; **⋮ More actions menu:** Refresh · Import · Export · Settings (locked on) · Outbound API · Delete All.

enhancements.description: new Access property **Record Lock Roles** (`recordLockRoles`, MULTI_SELECT of workspace; role ids, registered in `parameterMetadata.js`). When set, the Record Lock Field/Value lock only; holds callers who have one of those roles; other roles can still edit. Unset = everyone, exactly; as before. `recordAccessPolicy.js` adds `lockCoversCaller`; `evaluateRecordAccess` /; `evaluateRecordCreate` take `callerRoleIds`, and `assertRecordWritable` / `assertRecordCreatable`; read them from the request context, so neither save path (`featureData.service.updateFeatureData`,; `unified-event-processor` Submit) needed changing. `user.context.middleware.js` now puts; `roleIds` (token `role` + `workspaceRole`) into that context. A caller with no known roles; (worker, no request) is never held by a role-scoped lock. The workflow's Update/Upsert Record; nodes write to Mongo directly and never pass through this check.
enhancements.benefit: RCF bugs 4/25 (PMT #1963): the Initiator could edit an RCF at every stage after submit.; A plain lock would also lock the Owner/COO, who must keep working on it. With Lock Field =; Workflow Phase, Values = VALIDATION, OWNER, ASSIGNEE, COO, ACTIONS_PENDING, CLOSED and Roles =; Initiator, only the Initiator is held, and only while the RCF is with someone else.

enhancements.description: `/release/download-pdf/:id` (both the template and no-template branches) and; `/release/:id/generate-pdf-with-ai` no longer launch this service's Puppeteer. The HTML is; still built here (token substitution, flow fix, print-safe CSS); the PDF is rendered by; `cadp_template_backend_nodejs` `POST /templates/render/html-pdf` via a signed; `x-service-auth` token (same pattern as reportExport.service.js). Upstream failures map to 502.; `pdf-generation.service.js` remains only for SOP export.
enhancements.benefit: The template service owns PDF generation; one Puppeteer pipeline.

enhancements.description: The AI prompt (`buildAiPrompt`) now also asks for a structured `document`:; overview paragraphs → modules (grouped by each change's module) → per-change Title /; Description / Purpose / Illustrative Example (text, bullets, optional table) / Expected; Benefit / Note → overall benefits → conclusion. Existing response fields are unchanged.; New `releaseDocument.service.js` validates that JSON against the real confirmed items:; invented entityIds are dropped, skipped items get a deterministic block, all text is; HTML-escaped, and Module items aren't repeated as their own sub-block. Without an AI; integration, or when the AI fails, the same structure is built deterministically.; Generate/Preview responses now include `generatedJson.document` and `templateTokens`; (`release_document`, `module_sections`, `summary_table`, `overall_benefits`, `conclusion`,; plus rich `new_features`/`enhancements`/`improvements`/`bug_fixes`/`removed`/`deprecated`).; The no-template PDF/HTML uses `release_document`; template PDFs get the same tokens through; `buildTemplatePreviewData`. Content is still regenerated on every Generate/Preview/Download; (by decision — not persisted).
enhancements.benefit: Generate should produce a proper release document, not a bullet list.

enhancements.description: Generate/Preview responses now include `aiStatus { requested, used, error }`. A failed AI; call (e.g. the LLM gateway returning 502) is no longer silent: the error is mapped to a readable; message (gateway unavailable / credentials rejected / timeout / unreadable reply). Deterministic; fallback descriptions now read "The Owner Filter business rule has been added in this release."; instead of "Owner Filter (BusinessRule) has been new."
enhancements.benefit: Generate showed basic content with no indication that the AI never ran (observed 2026-10-13: llmgatewaydev.ckdigital.in returned 502 for every request).

enhancements.description: `resolveLlmGatewayUrl` (integration.service.js) sends chat requests to `<origin>/chat/completions`; when the integration's stored URL is the gateway origin or its model-listing endpoint (`…/models?…`).; Other stored paths are used as-is. The model-list and file-upload URLs already used only the origin and are unchanged.
enhancements.benefit: The "AI Models" LLM integration stored `https://llmgatewaydev.ckdigital.in/models?...`, so every chat POST went; to /models and failed with 405 ("AI drafting failed — Request failed with status code 405" on release 07d9c13b…).; Verified live after the fix: release 07d9c13b… drafted by gpt-5.2 through that integration in about 10 seconds.

enhancements.description: `confirmItems` now also accepts `generated` and `changes_requested` releases, so an author can go back to; Review Changes / Business Notes and run Generate again. Only `draft` advances to `items_confirmed`; other statuses; are kept, so a sent-back release stays in its approval stage. `in_review`, approved and published releases stay locked,; with a clearer error message.
enhancements.benefit: Going back after Generate failed with "Cannot confirm items once a release has moved past review (status=generated)".

enhancements.description: Generated release HTML (document blocks, notes, tables, changelog, delivered-items/grouped-changes) no longer; hardcodes font-size, font-family or color. It inherits from the element its token sits in, and headings and labels; differ only by weight.; `normalizeFlowPositioning` also strips `<hr>` and border-top/border-bottom lines outside tables, including in; already-saved templates. Table cell borders and boxed cards are kept.
enhancements.benefit: In Generate/Preview, generated text rendered in a different size/style from the template text, and section; headings had horizontal lines.

enhancements.description: The template editor saves styles as `#id{…}` CSS rules, so the inline-only line strip missed them. `buildPrintSafeCss`; now appends an override (`hr` hidden; no border-top/bottom outside tables) after the template CSS. List unwrapping replaces; the list with a `div` that keeps its id/class, so the template's `#id` font-size/color still apply (generated text had; fallen back to a larger default). Single-item token-holder lists (e.g. `{{overview}}` as a bullet) are unwrapped too, so; all values line up; generated lists (inline list-style) are untouched.

`operationMatchesTrigger` (`workflow.event.mapper.js`) honours a new trigger config key; `runOnUpdate`. When it is `true` on a `feature-submit` trigger, the workflow also starts when an; existing record is submitted again (`operationType` `update`/`edit`). Unset or anything but; `true` keeps the 2026-10-08 behaviour (Feature Submit = create only, `d0c3116`); Feature Update; triggers are unchanged. The Workflow Builder's start-node panel shows the tick box for Feature; Submit events (frontend `StartNodeConfigPanel.tsx`); `workflow-nodes-guide.js` documents the key; for the AI builder.
enhancements.benefit: RCF Tracker's "RCF Ticket Flow Manual" starts on the Submit RCF button and, by design,; restarts when the COO returns an RCF and the Initiator re-submits it (its first step only lets; a new or `INITIATOR`-phase RCF through). Since `d0c3116` that re-submit is an update, so the; trigger silently skipped it (`No matching trigger` is debug-level): RF00020 and RF00005 sat at; "Returned to Initiator" after the Initiator's Update saved fine.

enhancements.description: Transaction Settings → Access gets **Record Lock Roles** (`recordLockRoles`, a role; picker storing a JSON list of workspace role ids). With roles picked, the record lock holds only; users in those roles; unset = everyone, as before.; `recordAccessPolicy.ts`: `lockCoversCaller`, `useCallerRoleIds` (token `role` +; `workspaceRole`), `evaluateRecordAccess` takes `callerRoleIds`, new `useRecordAccessSettings`.; `useRecordAccessPolicy` now passes the caller's roles itself, so the View page (Edit button; hidden + form read-only when locked) works per role with **no change to `PreviewPage.tsx`**.; `TransactionManagement.tsx`: rows the caller may not edit get `canEdit: false`, so the row; menu (table/list/grid/card) shows no Edit — same rule as the View page. `KanbanCard.tsx` now; honours `record.canEdit` / `record.canDelete` like the row menu.; Settings screen: `role-picker` editor kind (`paramRowFreeze.ts`), `RolePicker`; (`ParamValueCell.tsx`), role names in `ParamValueDisplay.tsx`, shared `workspaceRoles.ts`; loader, catalog label in `useParamConfigRules.ts`, Access bucket mapping in; `transactionSettingsClosed.ts`.; The server enforces the same rule (master `recordAccessPolicy.js`, see its; `transaction-parameters.md`).
enhancements.benefit: after submit the Initiator could Edit (and Delete) an RCF at every stage. Delete is a; role setting (Initiator → RCF Tracker → Delete = No). Edit needs "only on your turn": Lock Field =; Workflow Phase, Values = VALIDATION, OWNER, ASSIGNEE, COO, ACTIONS_PENDING, CLOSED, Roles =; Initiator. The Initiator keeps Edit before submit, when sent back (INITIATOR) and at Initiator; Review (REVIEW).

enhancements.description: `GeneratedContent` gains `generatedJson.document` and `templateTokens`. PreviewTab; merges `templateTokens` into the custom-template token map, so `{{new_features}}` etc. render the; rich per-change blocks and the new `{{release_document}}`, `{{module_sections}}`, `{{summary_table}}`,; `{{overall_benefits}}` and `{{conclusion}}` tokens resolve. With no template, the fixed layout shows the; backend-rendered document, and the outline lists its modules, summary, benefits and conclusion.; The template editor's ReleaseNote variable list includes the new tokens.

On the Business Notes tab the Generate button reads "Regenerate" once the release has been generated, and re-runs; confirm items → save notes → generate → Preview. Local status updates now mirror the backend (a regenerate or a Review; Changes save no longer resets the status).
PreviewTab strips `<hr>` and border-top/bottom lines outside tables (mirrors the backend). Template Library; presets no longer draw lines under section headings or above footers.

Scoped override CSS removes `hr` and border-top/bottom outside tables (including `#id` rules saved by the editor).; List unwrapping keeps the list's id/class so the template's font-size applies, and one-item token-holder lists are unwrapped.; Mirrors the backend.

New `canEditRelease(status)` in releaseNoteDisplay.tsx. It is false for `in_review` (Pending Approval), `published`; and `archived`. The release list's row menu and the View page now hide Edit for those statuses (the list previously only; disabled it for published/archived, and the View page always showed it). The edit page goes read-only for the same; statuses, even when its URL is opened directly.

whatToTest: Approve/Reject `/execute` payload keyed by fieldId — `executeEventBinding` now builds `data` for `approve`, `reject` and `partial-approve` bindings with the same `buildSubmitStoragePayload` used by feature-submit: keys are field ids, `_metadata` is no longer sent, and `metadata.idTolabel` / `metadata.fieldCatalog` are always attached.; When no canvas field list is available, the form data is sent as-is (already fieldId-keyed) with `metadata.idTolabel` from the id→label map.; Extracted the shared record stamping (`currentDataVersion`, `__version`, `_createdByUsername`, `_operationType`, `saveFeatureDataPayload`, `id`) into one helper used by every branch.; Custom events and email/SMS triggers are unchanged (still label-keyed). Submit and Save as Draft are unchanged.
knownIssues: Because some menu structures have changed, certain features may return a 403 status code. To resolve this, edit the role, select the platform feature, and save the role again.
Use the conventional feature-wise approach wherever workflow scheduling is required.
Formula Builder UI – Field Insertion Through Typing
This works in current fields. For external feature fields, it won't work, as there could be fields with same names from multiple features.
Formula Builder – AI-Based Formula Writing/Editing Not Implemented
Organization Details → Basic Info: Website URL accepts invalid URL formats without validation.
Expected: Validate the URL format and show an error message for invalid values, such as www.example or example@123.www.example
Builder Tool Not Available on Mobile Web
The builder tool is not supported on mobile web. This is implemented as expected — builder functionality is restricted to desktop browsers by design. It should be available on Tab though.
Mobile – Formula Field Not Working in Tables & Charts
Formula fields are not evaluated correctly when used inside Tables and Charts on mobile. This is under review.
apiChanges: Service-only HTML→PDF endpoint for the Release Notes export

Added `POST /templates/render/html-pdf` ({ html, css?, defaultFont?, paperSetup?, fileName? } →; application/pdf). It wraps the existing `pdfGenerationService.generatePdf` (no binding, no; pagination) and only accepts service tokens (`x-service-auth`, `req.user.kind === 'service'`);; browser tokens get 403. Called by cadp_client_ws_backend_nodejs for `/release/download-pdf`; and generate-pdf-with-ai. Verified over HTTP with a client-ws-signed service token.
